pr_title: Consider current culture while searching in settings
pr_body:
- Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/14802
- [x] Depends on https://github.com/ppy/osu-framework/pull/5174

Search in settings only searches in english terms because their FilterTerms use LocalisedString.ToString(), which passes the default value (english, which is then used by framework's SearchContainer to make matches). 

My solution is using LocalisationManager to pass the string in it's appropiate culture, however I'm not sure if creating a new LocalisationManager for each element that needs it is efficient, so any suggestions would be appreciated.
pr_comments:
This is not the right direction for solving such issue, bindables should not be allocated for *every* single filterable implementation *every* time a filter is changed.

What might at the very least work instead is turning `FilterTerms` into an enumerable of `LocalisableString`s, and have a way to evaluate the string without allocating a bindable for it in `SearchContainer` itself, and update the filter on localisation change.
Going to supersede this PR via https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/18299, which is more up-to-date for anyone that needs to test with a local framework.

issue_context.title: Search in settings should consider localised strings' current culture
issue_context.body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/14801
Originally posted by **Tudi20** September 19, 2021 Search in settings should take the current language into consideration. Currently, the search in settings only searches for the English terms.

review_comments: In addition, the base english text should also always be included, as many people who use a non-english language will still search for keywords in english (by habit or preference).
